name: Financial services
description: Trust-led discovery across wealth, treasury, lending, and risk-sensitive decisions.
guardrails: Ground recommendations in the customer profile

scenarios.title: Retirement rollover discovery
scenarios.objective: Understand goals, time horizon, liquidity needs, and risk before discussing a rollover.

scenarios.title: Wealth-transfer planning
scenarios.objective: Surface family priorities, advisor relationships, tax-team dependencies, and decision criteria.

scenarios.title: Commercial treasury review
scenarios.objective: Diagnose cash visibility, payment risk, working-capital friction, and implementation constraints.

scenarios.title: Growth lending needs analysis
scenarios.objective: Clarify use of funds, repayment capacity, timing, alternatives, and risk posture.

scenarios.title: Fees and conflict objection
scenarios.objective: Address fee skepticism transparently without minimizing costs or making unsupported claims.

name: B2B SaaS
description: Multi-stakeholder software buying with value, adoption, security, and procurement pressure.

scenarios.title: Operations workflow discovery
scenarios.objective: Map the current process, quantify manual work, and determine whether deeper discovery is justified.

scenarios.title: Technical validation
scenarios.objective: Clarify architecture, data flow, integration ownership, and acceptance criteria without overclaiming.

scenarios.title: CFO value case
scenarios.objective: Translate discovered operational problems into a credible, measurable value hypothesis.

scenarios.title: Security and privacy review
scenarios.objective: Understand data sensitivity, controls, review process, and evidence required for approval.

scenarios.title: Renewal and procurement negotiation
scenarios.objective: Defend value, investigate concessions, and establish a fair decision path without premature discounting.

name: Healthcare & medical devices
description: Clinical, operational, technical, and value-analysis buying with patient-safety constraints.
guardrails: Do not make unsupported clinical claims

scenarios.title: Clinician workflow discovery
scenarios.objective: Understand clinical workflow, patient population, current limitations, and desired outcomes.

scenarios.title: Value-analysis committee
scenarios.objective: Build a balanced clinical, operational, and economic case with explicit evidence requirements.

scenarios.title: Operational workflow review
scenarios.objective: Surface staffing, training, throughput, safety, and adoption constraints.

scenarios.title: Clinical IT integration
scenarios.objective: Map interoperability, security, data governance, validation, and support ownership.

scenarios.title: Procurement and compliance
scenarios.objective: Navigate contracting, evidence, vendor policy, and implementation risk without unsupported claims.

name: Cybersecurity
description: Risk-based buying across security operations, governance, architecture, and procurement.

scenarios.title: Security platform consolidation
scenarios.objective: Understand tool sprawl, risk priorities, economics, and migration constraints.

scenarios.title: SOC workflow and alert fatigue
scenarios.objective: Map alert volume, triage workflow, staffing pressure, and measurable success.

scenarios.title: Incident readiness review
scenarios.objective: Discover response gaps, dependencies, recovery priorities, and executive expectations.

scenarios.title: Secure software procurement
scenarios.objective: Clarify secure-development evidence, supplier risk, remediation, and approval requirements.

scenarios.title: Executive cyber-risk discussion
scenarios.objective: Translate technical exposure into decision-relevant operational and financial risk.

name: Industrial & manufacturing
description: Operational selling around throughput, reliability, workforce, safety, and capital discipline.

scenarios.title: Plant automation discovery
scenarios.objective: Map manual work, constraints, safety, throughput, and automation readiness.

scenarios.title: Unplanned downtime reduction
scenarios.objective: Diagnose failure patterns, production impact, current maintenance process, and evidence needs.

scenarios.title: Supply-chain resilience
scenarios.objective: Surface supplier concentration, lead-time variability, working capital, and mitigation priorities.

scenarios.title: Skilled-workforce constraints
scenarios.objective: Connect labor availability, training, quality, and capacity to an actionable operating case.

scenarios.title: Technical procurement validation
scenarios.objective: Align engineering, operations, commercial terms, qualification, and implementation risk.

name: Automotive retail
description: Transparent, needs-based vehicle sales across discovery, trade, financing, and ownership.
guardrails: Be transparent about price and terms

scenarios.title: Showroom needs discovery
scenarios.objective: Understand use, passengers, driving patterns, priorities, timing, and budget range.

scenarios.title: Trade-in value discussion
scenarios.objective: Set a transparent appraisal process and separate trade value from the new-vehicle decision.

scenarios.title: Financing transparency
scenarios.objective: Clarify budget and preferences while explaining terms without steering or pressure.

scenarios.title: Competitor and price objection
scenarios.objective: Investigate comparison criteria and position value without attacking competitors.

scenarios.title: Service retention conversation
scenarios.objective: Understand service concerns, restore confidence, and agree on a practical resolution.

name: Residential real estate
description: Advisory selling across representation, financing, listings, negotiation, and transaction risk.
guardrails: Do not guarantee price or appreciation

scenarios.title: First-time buyer consultation
scenarios.objective: Clarify goals, financing readiness, timing, representation, and property tradeoffs.

scenarios.title: Competitive listing presentation
scenarios.objective: Understand motivation and expectations, then explain evidence, process, and positioning.

scenarios.title: Financing readiness conversation
scenarios.objective: Discuss readiness, contingency, timing, and lender coordination without giving financial advice.

scenarios.title: Multiple-offer negotiation
scenarios.objective: Clarify priorities and risk tolerance while explaining options without guaranteeing acceptance.

scenarios.title: Inspection and appraisal recovery
scenarios.objective: De-escalate concerns, clarify facts and options, and establish an accountable decision process.
